text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (—That day was scorching hot too.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "...Eeeeh~? Why is it so hot outside...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, no no no~! I don't wanna take even a 
single step~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, the room was freezing cold, after 
all. ...Now Sweepy, hold out your hands.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...? Like this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: 『Refresh shower』！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!? That smells amazing! Grandma, what was 
that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! What I just sprayed on ya is 
magic spray! ...Look, is the scent really 
all you're curious about?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...! Grandma, your hands are so cool! So 
wonderfully cool!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, right? As you walk, it'll get 
even colder and feel amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Really!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It really is, Grandma! It's so cold! 
Ahaha, I wonder what'll happen once I 
start running!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Grandma's magic really is amazing, 
isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Grandma. Is 'racing magic' even 
more wonderful than the magic we have now?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! My greatest magic is, you 
see—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —...Watch me, Grandma.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just a little more, and I'll—

During a break at summer camp, Sweep 
Tosho, who had been taking a nap in the 
shade of a tree, got up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! It'd be a waste of time 
otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the "Little Witch" Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
It really is you~! You were so cool in the 
Oaks the other day☆ Good luck in the Shuka 
Sho~!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! If we're talking about someone in 
the spotlight, it's definitely Sweep-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, pay attention! I'll cast my racing 
magic on all of you, too!

text_block_list.name: Women
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! So cuuute!

And after finishing training, while 
relaxing at the training camp lodge—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, familiar! Perfect timing. Open your 
mouth for a second!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'why'?! Your master 
ordered you to, so open your mouth 
already!!

Sweep Tosho gave me orders without taking 
no for an answer. The pressure radiating 
from her was extraordinary—
choice_data_list:
This is terrifying! Resist with all your 
might.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, why?! Familiar!
choice_data_list: I have a bad feeling about this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, would you shut up with all the 
nagging already?!

Sweep Tosho forcibly pinched and pulled at 
my cheeks with her hands.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! You're a grown-up, so behave 
yourself! ...Take that!!"
(Plop...)

In that instant, the sweet flavor of honey 
spread throughout my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's Grandma's special candy. It's 
enchanted with magic to make you feel 
better right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's been so hot day after day, after all. 
It'd be a pain if you collapsed on me, so 
I thought I'd share some with you.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'm only giving you one of them, though. 
There were only two left!"

The candy she gave me was sweeter than any 
variety I had ever tasted. The sugar 
gently seeped through my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's the spirit! ...Take that!
(Squish!)

In that instant, a raw, grassy flavor 
fills my mouth. The seasoning was likely 
left entirely to nature. Freshly picked—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Grandma told me. Mugwort is the 
queen of herbs, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's been so hot lately, so before you 
collapse, you'd better build up your 
stamina with this!
choice_data_list:
You were looking out for me, weren't 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Managing her familiar is a magical girl's 
duty! Of course I do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let me have a bite too, then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you planning to keep all the 
mugwort I picked for yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way! I can't afford to collapse here 
either!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I know the truth. Mugwort is 
suuuuper tasty, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved when Grandma first made it 
for me!
choice_data_list:
That's probably because it's already been 
cooked—

text_block_list.text: (Chomp!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...It's SOOOOO BITTEEEEERRR!?
